metadata.scenario: An automated robocall about extending the office's car warranty. The receptionist listens for a few seconds, realizes it's spam, and hangs up. Very short call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Uh, hi, this is William Chen. I’m just checking in on my car warranty extension. Sir, this is CareFirst Home Health, not a car warranty service. Oh, I think I got a robocall or something. Yes, it seems like a spam call. We don’t handle that here. Right, right. Sorry about that. No problem! Is there anything healthcare-related I can assist you with? Actually, I did want to ask about my physical therapy schedule. Sure, let me pull up your information. I had a visit just two days ago, and I’m wondering when the next one is. Your next physical therapy appointment is scheduled for this Friday at 10 AM. Great! I was also thinking about adding some more personal care assistance. We can certainly help with that. Would you like to schedule a caregiver? Yes, maybe for two hours a few times a week? I can connect you with Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, for that. Sounds good, thank you! Let me transfer you to her. What’s your best contact number? It’s still the same, +13165554321. Perfect, I’ll have Lisa reach out shortly to discuss your needs. Thanks, Margaret! I appreciate your help. You’re welcome, William. Have a great day! You too! Bye. Goodbye!
